race.comment: YELLOWKNIFE (5) was an impressive maiden winner last time out, scoring by 1.75 lengths over 1200m at Pakenham Synthetic. Is lightly raced and has plenty of scope for improvement in what looks another winnable affair, go close. FOREVER WITH NED (3) finished tenth two runs back then did well last start but found a couple better over 1200m at Echuca, beaten only 1.3 lengths after being in contention on the turn. Did win only run here and should take beating. BELLA KATELYN (8) produced a fair effort to finish 2.25 lengths away in sixth last start over 1200m at Corowa after a win the run before. Still lightly raced and maps well, consider.  SHELLY'S LEGACY (6) will need a slice of luck from the inside but will be running on if the gaps open.
